issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台从源码抓到 25f，只渲染出开头全景 hold，三连特写和甩回全部丢失
三个特写都是浅灰底上一张 4px 灰边大白卡，按钮是灰块里一根白条、光标是黑圆点，读不出是什么控件
翻牌是整块黑卡 rotateX，没有翻牌的上下分片与铰线；开关是平涂灰 / 黑轨道
甩回靠三份整页 dashboard 错帧叠加冒充模糊，甩入时左侧大片空白
结果是在中上卡片上盖一块半透明白板 + 5px 黑边 + 260px 大 "1"，把卡片内容整个遮掉，泛光是白色外溢
changes: 补 WRIGHT_TRIPLE_CUT_DURATION = 130；三特写 25/35/45 各 10f（静 4 / 动 3 / 静 3）、二值跳变、55 帧 6f poly(5) 甩回全部保留
特写底改为同一页面 2.6x 超近虚焦（blur 14px，微距景深）+ 柔光压亮；前景换成成品控件：靛蓝渐变 "Deploy" 按钮 + macOS 箭头光标，按下时阴影 26→5 收缩、下沉 8px
开关做成 iOS 式：内凹轨道灰→强调色、白色圆钮带两层软阴影，滑动途中横向拉伸 46px 再收回；翻牌改分体翻页（上片翻倒 → 下片落下 + 铰线 + 翻页暗面）
甩回改用按速度的横向 SpeedBlur（峰值封顶 30px），上一镜翻牌特写同步甩出画左，首尾相接不留空
结果改为 Deploys 卡同 seed 副本抬起 8px / 1.02 过冲 + 2px 强调色描边与同色柔光 + "+1" 角标弹出，卡外 10% 圆角挖空压暗收视线，84 帧起真静止
issuesEn: No exported duration; the workbench grabbed 25f from the source, so only the opening wide hold rendered and the three close-ups and whip were lost
All three close-ups were a big white card with a 4px grey border on light grey; the button was a white bar in a grey block and the cursor a black dot, so the controls were unreadable
The flip was a whole black card on rotateX, with no split halves or hinge; the toggle was a flat grey/black track
The whip faked blur by stacking three full dashboards at frame offsets, leaving a large empty area on the left as it slid in
The result covered the top-middle card with a translucent white slab, a 5px black border and a 260px '1', hiding the card's content behind a white glow spill
changesEn: Added WRIGHT_TRIPLE_CUT_DURATION = 130; close-ups at 25/35/45, 10f each (4 still / 3 action / 3 still), binary switches and the 6f poly(5) whip at frame 55 all kept

Close-ups sit on a 2.6x defocused view of the same page (14px blur, macro depth of field) with a soft light lift; foregrounds are finished controls: an indigo gradient 'Deploy' button and a macOS arrow cursor, with the shadow shrinking 26→5 as it presses down 8px

iOS-style toggle: inset track goes grey→accent and the white knob, with a two-layer soft shadow, stretches 46px mid-slide before settling; the counter is now a split-flap (top flap falls, bottom flap drops, with hinge line and a shaded underside)
The whip uses velocity-driven horizontal SpeedBlur (peak capped at 30px), and the flip close-up exits left in step so the frame never shows a gap

The result is a same-seed copy of the Deploys card lifting 8px with a 1.02 overshoot, a 2px accent outline with matching glow and a '+1' badge pop; a 10% rounded cut-out scrim dims everything else, with a true hold from frame 84
